MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic:
REVIVE is fantastic!
Give it to a fainted POKéMON, and the POKéMON will arise.
But be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore the used-up PP of moves.
MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelLastsLong:
MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away.
Out of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts the longest.
MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRa:
The NET and DIVE BALLS are rare POKé BALLS that are only made in MOSSDEEP.
A NET BALL is effective against BUG-type and WATER-type POKéMON.
A DIVE BALL works best on POKéMON at the bottom of the sea.
